papers.title: Demystifying Agent Skills: Why They Work-Until They Don't
papers.desc: Skills have emerged as a practical and effective approach for enhancing LLM agents at inference time through structured packages of knowledge.

papers.title: FreeToken: Efficient Edge-Native MoE Serving with Bandwidth-Adaptive Execution
papers.desc: Frontier open-weight models are increasingly available, but serving them still largely assumes datacenter infrastructure.

papers.title: EDITBRIDGE: Towards Faithful and Efficient Ultra-High-Resolution Image Editing
papers.desc: High-resolution image editing is increasingly demanded in professional workflows, yet existing diffusion-based models remain constrained to resolutions below 1K due to quadratic attention complexity and prohibitive memory requirements.

papers.title: Agent Lightning v1.0: Towards Harnessed Agentic RL
papers.desc: Modern agents operate inside agent harnesses that manage tools, context, and control flow, making the harness a critical part of the agent system.

papers.title: CoinVE-200K: A Large-Scale High-Quality Dataset for Compositional Instruction-Guided Video Editing
papers.desc: The quality and diversity of instruction-based video editing datasets are steadily improving, yet existing datasets mainly focus on single editing operations and fall short in supporting compositional instruction-guided video editing.

papers.title: V-RAE: Rethinking Video Latent Spaces for Generation
papers.desc: Latent video generation relies on autoencoders to define a compact space in which generative models operate.

papers.title: DiSCO: Defending text-to-image generation through distribution-guided contrastive prompt optimization
papers.desc: As text-to-image generative models advance, they raise critical safety concerns, particularly the generation of Not-Safe-For-Work (NSFW) content such as violence and nudity, further exacerbated by red-teaming adversarial attacks.

papers.title: HarnessRisk: A Lifecycle-Oriented Benchmark for Agent Harness Safety
papers.desc: Large language models are increasingly deployed through agent harnesses that manage tools, extensions, persistent state, permissions, and external actions.

papers.title: MathForm: Scaling Mathematical Autoformalization with Knowledge Retrieval and Verification-Guided Refinement
papers.desc: Autoformalization is commonly framed as translating natural-language mathematical statements into machine-verifiable formal languages such as Lean 4.

papers.title: Personalized Auto-Research: Towards a True AI Co-Scientist
papers.desc: AI co-scientists that generate hypotheses, retrieve related work, design experiments, execute code, and draft full papers are beginning to change how research is carried out.

papers.title: Cross-Model Memory Transfer via Target-Side Reader Adaptation
papers.desc: Methods for improving knowledge use in large language models typically fall into two regimes.

papers.title: CardioState-JEPA: Delay-Aware Cross-Modal Learning of a Shared Cardiac Representation
papers.desc: Electrocardiography (ECG), photoplethysmography (PPG), and phonocardiography (PCG) provide complementary views of the same cardiac cycle, yet existing cardiac foundation models are trained for a single sensing modality, leaving the shared physiology across sensors unexploited.

papers.title: MoE-ViE: Mixture of Experts Vision Encoder for Efficient Image and Video Understanding
papers.desc: Vision encoders are a critical component of vision-language models, and scaling their capacity effectively improves performance.

papers.title: Unifying Graph Neural Networks Through a Common Layer Equation
papers.desc: Graph neural networks are commonly described through family-specific equations whose notation obscures shared computations and structural differences.

papers.title: PixRestore: Unified Image Restoration via Pixel Diffusion Transformer
papers.desc: Unified image restoration (UIR) aims to recover high-quality (HQ) content from low-quality (LQ) images with different degradations using a single model.
